title: Audit event reconciliation
method: Synthetic fixed window. Deduplicate on producer and event ID. Compare selected operations with searchable unique events; retransmitted envelopes do not increase the denominator. The thirty missing events are deliberately queued in this exercise.
alt: Audit event reconciliation: Expected operations 10000 unique events, Initially searchable 9970 unique events, After queue recovery 10000 unique events. Illustrative inputs.
